== Biography ==

== Trivia ==
*Nicknamed "50 Yuan top" by Chinese fans. Prior to the 2021 season, [[Royal Never Give Up|RNG]] invited Ale to try out for the team. But after Ale arrived at RNG's base, RNG told him that they had already decided to switch [[Xiaohu]] to top. Assistant Coach [[Poppy (Chang Po-Hao)|Poppy]] gave Ale 50 CNY (about 7.7 USD) for compensating him to take a taxi home and keep the change to buy some drinks.<ref>[https://lujuba.cc/en/524811.html Article via lujuba ]''lujaba.cc''</ref>
* Reached 1000 kills in the LPL on July 22, 2023.
** The 44th player and 6th toplaner to reach 1000 kills in the LPL.
** Achieved it in the same series as [[Able]]'s 1000 kills milestone.
* Reached 500 games in the LPL on May 21, 2025.
** The 33rd player to reach 500 games in the LPL.
*Was famous within China and Korea for reaching and hovering between rank 1 and 2 in the Korean server under the name "Huntiand1"
**Got caught up in a scandal when [[Doran (Choi Hyeon-joon)|Doran]] got banned from competitive play for 1 game for "trolling" after playing a game of solo queue against him and dying 15 times in 2019.

=== Individual Awards ===
* LPL 2nd All Pro Team x1 (Split 1 2025)
